headline: The TYPO3 Action API
headline_accent: A typed API for the backend, integrations and AI agents.
lead: An action is a typed PHP method that the backend, external applications and AI agents can call. TYPO3 validates the input and the output, documents the action and checks the access, so the action needs no controller.

channels.title: TYPO3 backend
channels.text: JavaScript client instead of AJAX routes

channels.title: AI agents
channels.text: MCP tools, over HTTP or stdio

facts.title: Single implementation
facts.text: The same PHP method serves the backend, integrations and AI agents.

facts.title: Typed and validated
facts.text: TYPO3 derives the JSON Schema from the PHP types and checks the input and the output.

facts.title: User permissions
facts.text: Backend permissions apply, and scopes limit the actions that an app can call.

facts.title: Built-in MCP server
facts.text: The MCP server offers every action as a tool.
